newsitem.title: USA: US spot jet slides down tracking NYMEX, diffs hold.
newsitem.headline: US spot jet slides down tracking NYMEX, diffs hold.

text.p: Jet fuel prices continued their slide Wednesday on the back of the sharp three-day NYMEX selloff.
Differentials in New York Harbor (NYH) and the U.S. Gulf (USG) held steady, and traders said few deals were done.
NYMEX January heating oil shed nearly 3 cents going into the close, pressured by heavy technical selling and the bearish weekly inventory figures from the American Petroleum Institute.
USG prompt 54-grade barrels were talked at 2.00 cents under the screen, while NYH 54-grade sat at 2.00 cents over.
-- Matt Daily, New York Energy Desk +1 212 859 1626
